summary: Specifies the RTP payload format for carrying ITU Recommendation BT.656-3 video streams. It lets this kind of digital video be sent in real time over IP. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: It says how to cut up a certain kind of digital video into packets for sending, and how to glue the packets back together at the other end.

questions: how is bt.656 video sent over rtp
what is the rtp payload for bt.656
